items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, the same underlying model with Fable carrying strong cyber/biology safeguards for general availability. Outputs are up to 30% faster than 5.1 at lower pricing ($8/$40 per million tokens).
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2，底層模型相同，Fable 帶有強健網路/生物安全防護供一般可用。輸出比 5.1 快最多 30%，定價更低（每百萬 tokens $8/$40）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is Anthropic’s clearest push to claim leadership on hard technical and scientific work just as it starts IPO marketing. The dual Fable/Mythos access model continues its verification approach.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic 在啟動 IPO 行銷之際，最明確主張硬技術與科學工作領導地位的推廣。雙重 Fable/Mythos 存取模式延續其驗證方法。
items_flat.quote: Our most capable models for daunting technical work, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 set a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們針對艱鉅技術工作最有能力的模型 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2，在編碼、金融與科學領域樹立新標竿。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow at $70–78 per share
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 IPO 路演，每股 70–78 美元
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed IPO of Class A common stock. The offering covers 825 million shares (most primary), with an expected price range of $70–78 per share and a Nasdaq listing under “ANT.” Underwriters received the mandate.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic, PBC 啟動 Class A 普通股擬議 IPO 路演。發行涵蓋 8.25 億股（多數為新股），預期價格區間每股 70–78 美元，Nasdaq 上市代號「ANT」。承銷商已獲委任。
items_flat.analysis_en: The formal roadshow confirms Anthropic is moving ahead with a public listing while shipping a major model upgrade. Valuation and demand will be tested against recent AI-sector volatility.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 正式路演確認 Anthropic 在推出重大模型升級之際推進公開上市。估值與需求將面臨近期 AI 板塊波動的考驗。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock. The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天 Anthropic, PBC 啟動其 A 類普通股擬議首次公開發行路演。首次公開發行價格預計介於每股 70.00 至 78.00 美元之間。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Whiteboards, Sheets, Data and Meetings tools
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Whiteboards、Sheets、Data 與 Meetings 工具
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Whiteboards and Sheets in beta plus made Claude Data (formerly Dashboards) generally available on paid plans. Whiteboards let teams brainstorm with Claude on shared boards; Sheets generate editable spreadsheets; Data adds certified queries, stories and live sharing. Claude Meetings is rolling out in beta for Team/Enterprise on Google Meet as a visible participant that drafts plans in real time.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 在付費方案推出 Claude Whiteboards 與 Sheets beta，並將 Claude Data（原 Dashboards）正式上線。Whiteboards 讓團隊與 Claude 在共享板上腦力激盪；Sheets 可生成可編輯試算表；Data 新增認證查詢、故事與即時分享。Claude Meetings 正以 beta 形式為 Team/Enterprise 在 Google Meet 上推出，作為可見參與者即時起草計畫。
items_flat.analysis_en: The suite positions Claude as an active knowledge-work collaborator beyond coding, timed with the IPO roadshow. Adoption hinges on reliability in live meetings and whether basic Sheets functionality competes with existing Office/Google tools.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此套件將 Claude 定位為超越編碼的主動知識工作協作者，時機與 IPO 路演吻合。採用取決於即時會議可靠性，以及基礎 Sheets 功能能否與現有 Office/Google 工具競爭。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re launching Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets in beta, and Claude Dashboards becomes generally available as Claude Data.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Claude Whiteboards 與 Claude Sheets beta，並將 Claude Dashboards 正式上線為 Claude Data。

items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2.5
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, its most capable vision-language-action model. It improves dexterity, reliability and safety across 200+ tasks. In a Mercedes-Benz production proof-of-concept with Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid, it achieved high success on pick-and-pack.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini Robotics 2.5，其最強視覺-語言-動作模型。它在 200+ 任務中提升靈巧性、可靠性與安全。與 Apptronik Apollo 2 人形機器人在 Mercedes-Benz 生產概念驗證中，揀選包裝成功率高。
items_flat.analysis_en: The factory pilot is the most concrete real-world robotics result DeepMind has shown recently. Sustained high success outside controlled settings and broader partner adoption remain key tests.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 工廠試點是 DeepMind 近期展示的最具體真實世界機器人成果。在受控環境外維持高成功率與更廣夥伴採用仍是關鍵考驗。
items_flat.quote: During a real-world proof-of-concept on Mercedes-Benz production lines, our models helped Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid pick and pack automotive parts with a 96% success rate.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在 Mercedes-Benz 產線的真實世界概念驗證中，我們的模型協助 Apptronik 的 Apollo 2 人形機器人以 96% 成功率撿取並包裝汽車零件。

items_flat.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon now available to developers and consumers
items_flat.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 現已向開發者與消費者開放
items_flat.summary_en: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available via API in AI Studio and Gemini for business at the same introductory price as Argon ($2/$10 per million tokens). It is rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Antigravity, the Gemini app and Search.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 透過 AI Studio API 與 Gemini for business 開放 Gemini 4 Carbon，與 Argon 相同入門價格（每百萬 tokens $2/$10）。正向 Google AI Ultra 訂閱者在 Antigravity、Gemini 應用與搜尋中推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broad availability of Carbon expands Google’s frontier-model options beyond the earlier limited Fairwind cyber release. Pricing parity with Argon lowers the barrier, but sustained performance leadership is still to be proven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Carbon 廣泛可用擴大 Google 前沿模型選項，超越先前有限 Fairwind 網路發布。與 Argon 價格平價降低門檻，但持續性能領導地位仍待證明。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 4 Carbon is available via the API in Google AI Studio and Gemini for business for all paying developers and enterprises, at the same introductory price as Gemini 4 Argon ($2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens).
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 透過 Google AI Studio 與 Gemini for business 的 API 向所有付費開發者與企業開放，定價與 Gemini 4 Argon 相同（每百萬輸入 token $2、每百萬輸出 token $10）。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind’s AlphaProof Code formally verifies Signal protocol code
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 的 AlphaProof Code 正式驗證 Signal 協議程式碼
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, an agentic framework that formally verified key security properties of the actual compiled code of Signal’s libsignal implementation (including PQXDH and Triple Ratchet) down to machine-code level.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Code，代理框架正式驗證 Signal libsignal 實作實際編譯碼的關鍵安全屬性（包括 PQXDH 與 Triple Ratchet），深入機器碼層級。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bridging design-level and implementation-level proofs for a real cryptographic library is a meaningful milestone. Scalability beyond this single protocol and the residual trusted base remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 為真實密碼庫橋接設計層與實作層證明是有意義里程碑。超越單一協議的可擴展性與殘餘信任基礎仍是開放問題。
items_flat.quote: Our work marks the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth. It's also the first time the implementation of a widely deployed protocol like this has been formally verified by any method, with or without AI.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們的工作標誌著 AI 首次被用於以這種深度形式驗證廣泛部署的密碼學協定。這也是此類廣泛部署協定的實作首次被任何方法（無論有無 AI）形式驗證。

items_flat.title_en: Musk: Grok 4.8 pre-training done, soft Bot rollout later this week
items_flat.title_zh: Musk：Grok 4.8 預訓練完成，本週稍後軟性 Bot 推出
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that xAI dumped JAX/SGLang and rewrote the RL and inference stack in C/C++. Pre-training for Grok 4.8 is finished, the model is now in RL with rising evals, and a soft rollout to Grok Bot users is planned later this week.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文稱 xAI 棄用 JAX/SGLang，以 C/C++ 重寫 RL 與推論堆疊。Grok 4.8 預訓練完成，模型正進行 RL，評估上升，計畫本週稍後向 Grok Bot 用戶軟性推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post is the clearest public status update on 4.8 to date and sets expectations for a limited Bot-first rollout. Until public benchmarks or broader access appear, claims about capabilities stay provisional.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此帖是迄今最清晰的 4.8 公開狀態更新，設定有限 Bot 優先推出預期。在公開基準或更廣存取出現前，能力宣稱仍屬暫時性。
items_flat.quote: We will do a soft rollout to Bot users later this week and see how it goes. Grok 4.8 will bear no resemblance to 4.7 (thankfully).
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將本週稍後向 Bot 用戶軟性推出並觀察效果。Grok 4.8 將與 4.7 截然不同（幸好）。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT beta with Business Hub and Agents
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 推出 Businesses beta，含 Business Hub 與 Agents
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced Businesses in ChatGPT in beta. Through Business Hub, eligible businesses can claim their profile, update details, add product feeds, and view aggregated insights on mentions and clicks. Eligible U.S. ecommerce and online service businesses can create Business Agents.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 推出 Businesses beta。透過 Business Hub，符合資格企業可認領檔案、更新細節、加入產品饋送，並查看提及與點擊聚合洞察。符合資格的美國電商與線上服務企業可建立 Business Agents。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves ChatGPT further toward a commercial discovery and transaction surface for its large weekly user base. Privacy safeguards (no sharing of individual conversations) and the limited initial rollout will shape early adoption.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這使 ChatGPT 進一步成為其龐大每週用戶基數的商業發現與交易表面。隱私保護（不分享個別對話）與有限初始推出將塑造早期採用。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, giving businesses a new way to connect with the 1.2 billion people who use ChatGPT each week.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們以測試版推出 ChatGPT 中的商業功能，為企業提供與每週使用 ChatGPT 的 12 億人連結的新方式。

items_flat.title_en: Google and Artificial Analysis launch Multimodal Knowledge Agent benchmark
items_flat.title_zh: Google 與 Artificial Analysis 推出 Multimodal Knowledge Agent 基準
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind partnered with Artificial Analysis to launch the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark. It evaluates agents on 200 real-world visually complex knowledge-work tasks created with domain experts. Gemini 4 Carbon ranked #2 on the new eval.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 與 Artificial Analysis 合作推出 Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) 基準。它以領域專家創建的 200 項真實視覺複雜知識工作任務評估代理。Gemini 4 Carbon 在新評估中排名第 2。
items_flat.analysis_en: MKA addresses a real gap—most existing benchmarks ignore visual and layout-heavy professional work. Google’s strong cost-performance result on its own new eval is notable but will need external validation.
items_flat.analysis_zh: MKA 填補真實缺口——多數現有基準忽略視覺與版面密集專業工作。Google 在自身新評估上的強成本性能結果值得注意，但仍需外部驗證。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 4 Carbon achieves #2 in quality among the models we tested, and completes tasks at 6x lower cost on average compared to the top scoring model.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 在我們測試的模型中品質排名第二，並以較最高分模型低 6 倍的平均成本完成任務。

google.title_en: Google and Artificial Analysis launch Multimodal Knowledge Agent benchmark
google.title_zh: Google 與 Artificial Analysis 推出 Multimodal Knowledge Agent 基準
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind partnered with Artificial Analysis to launch the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark. It evaluates agents on 200 real-world visually complex knowledge-work tasks created with domain experts. Gemini 4 Carbon ranked #2 on the new eval.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 與 Artificial Analysis 合作推出 Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) 基準。它以領域專家創建的 200 項真實視覺複雜知識工作任務評估代理。Gemini 4 Carbon 在新評估中排名第 2。
google.analysis_en: MKA addresses a real gap—most existing benchmarks ignore visual and layout-heavy professional work. Google’s strong cost-performance result on its own new eval is notable but will need external validation.
google.analysis_zh: MKA 填補真實缺口——多數現有基準忽略視覺與版面密集專業工作。Google 在自身新評估上的強成本性能結果值得注意，但仍需外部驗證。
google.quote: Gemini 4 Carbon achieves #2 in quality among the models we tested, and completes tasks at 6x lower cost on average compared to the top scoring model.
google.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 在我們測試的模型中品質排名第二，並以較最高分模型低 6 倍的平均成本完成任務。

xai.title_en: Musk: Grok 4.8 pre-training done, soft Bot rollout later this week
xai.title_zh: Musk：Grok 4.8 預訓練完成，本週稍後軟性 Bot 推出
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk posted that xAI dumped JAX/SGLang and rewrote the RL and inference stack in C/C++. Pre-training for Grok 4.8 is finished, the model is now in RL with rising evals, and a soft rollout to Grok Bot users is planned later this week.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk 發文稱 xAI 棄用 JAX/SGLang，以 C/C++ 重寫 RL 與推論堆疊。Grok 4.8 預訓練完成，模型正進行 RL，評估上升，計畫本週稍後向 Grok Bot 用戶軟性推出。
xai.analysis_en: The post is the clearest public status update on 4.8 to date and sets expectations for a limited Bot-first rollout. Until public benchmarks or broader access appear, claims about capabilities stay provisional.
xai.analysis_zh: 此帖是迄今最清晰的 4.8 公開狀態更新，設定有限 Bot 優先推出預期。在公開基準或更廣存取出現前，能力宣稱仍屬暫時性。
xai.quote: We will do a soft rollout to Bot users later this week and see how it goes. Grok 4.8 will bear no resemblance to 4.7 (thankfully).
xai.quote_zh: 我們將本週稍後向 Bot 用戶軟性推出並觀察效果。Grok 4.8 將與 4.7 截然不同（幸好）。

brief_en: Anthropic ships workplace tools (Sheets, Whiteboards, Data; Meetings beta) amid IPO roadshow. Google expands Gemini 4 Carbon and Robotics 2.5. OpenAI adds Business Hub. xAI preps Grok 4.8 soft Bot rollout.
brief_zh: Anthropic 推出職場工具（Sheets、Whiteboards、Data；Meetings beta）並推進 IPO 路演。Google 擴大 Gemini 4 Carbon 與 Robotics 2.5。OpenAI 新增 Business Hub。xAI 準備 Grok 4.8 軟性 Bot 推出。
